SELECT id, user_name, id_card, phone, withholding_agent, should_pay, pre_deduct, actual_pay, diff_amount, recover_pay, tax_area, merchant, channel, sale, customer_service, status, create_time, update_time FROM tax
AND user_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{userName}, '%')
AND id_card LIKE CONCAT('%', #{idCard}, '%')
ORDER BY id DESC
